_comment: Copy to ~/.vibe-trading/watch_plans.json. The watchdog reads this every run, so you can edit it live — no restart needed. 'positions' sets per-holding stops/targets (overriding the defaults in watchdog.py). 'alerts' watches tickers you do NOT own yet and texts you when a price is crossed.
